subtitle: Lesson 9 · The same foundation, a different shape

eyebrow: A weekly trend view, by category and priority
code:
CREATE VIEW marts.vw_support_ticket_trends AS
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', opened_at) AS ticket_week,
  category,
  priority,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM marts.ticket_facts
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', opened_at),
         category, priority;
caption: Reads from ticket_facts — the upserted, current-state table from Lesson 6.

code:
CREATE VIEW marts.vw_support_open_tickets AS
SELECT ticket_id, subscriber_id, category,
       priority, status, opened_at
FROM marts.ticket_facts
WHERE status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed');
caption: No window function needed — current-state means one row per ticket, always.
